components.text: The Item Router is a standalone alternative to the full Routing Node network - a single self-contained block, essentially an enhanced hopper. It pulls items from its four horizontal sides and above, and pushes them into whatever inventory is directly below it.
Right-click it with a plain item in hand to toggle that item in its small built-in filter (holds up to 4 items). An empty filter lets everything through, behaving just like a plain hopper.

Right-click it with a Filter item (see the Filters entry) instead to install it, adding tag/mod id/enchantment/composite matching on top of the built-in filter - both have to agree for an item to pass. Sneak-right-click empty-handed to remove an installed Filter.
